pr.title: G02: complete Gin Rummy with verified offline gameplay
pr.body:
Current review status (2026-10-09): **draft — confirmed initial-presence defect**. At the unchanged d5fbb39746f8f7900bee57506e8133e8675f48ed head, a valid roster whose opening actor is already disconnected starts with no legal move for either player when the optional clock is off. An entirely disconnected initial roster also starts without the existing empty-room pause. A supplemental isolated repair initializes through the established absence policy; new full verification is pending. A separate Strong-bot case choosing a normal knock over available Gin is recorded for the next post-green improvement round.

The acceptance below describes the preserved d5fbb implementation and its actual earlier evidence. It does not certify the pending repair or remove the newly reproduced defects.

Implements complete Standard and Oklahoma Gin Rummy as a pure deterministic TypeScript core and a self-contained offline play.html. Two active players can play hot-seat or versus three bot levels; the requested three/four-seat winner-stays rotation keeps waiting hands private. Exact deadwood and joint meld/layoff solvers, knocking, Gin/Big Gin, undercuts, boxes/line bonuses, scoring presets and correct first-to-target results are covered.

The final verification repair preserves every game, card, host, template and HTML byte from the accepted 4fa969b implementation. It expands the browser guard from 5 to 35 loaded source/contract/checker/build/workflow inputs, gives each profile a unique attempt identity, retains every native RAF timestamp and active-hand witness, and independently verifies each full test's fresh raw reports and separate functional recordings. All 35 inputs from the earlier local failure are published with a byte-verified archive mapping.

Validation at exact final head **d5fbb39746f8f7900bee57506e8133e8675f48ed**:
- [Full CI 37834367995](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37834367995) succeeded at 19:53:24 UTC. Its actual 79,429-character job log was read.
- 52 tests passed with zero failures, cancellations, skips or TODOs; 6,000 complete edition/roster games and every-event replay; 1,003 property seeds; 10,000 independently checked exact deadwood hands and 2,000 independently checked joint layoffs.

pr.title: G03: complete Pack the Hold core, exact solver and offline play
pr.body:
Delivers Pack the Hold: an original timed polyomino race for 2–8 players, with the same seeded 6–12 valued crates, exact optimum scoring, calibrated difficulty tiers, 60/80/95% bots and a single offline HTML page with drag, touch, rotation and keyboard controls.

The resumed review preserves every original game, bot, HTML, calibration, fixture, manifest and template byte from 731b64b. It strengthens rendering verification: all 900 consecutive native RAF intervals per TV and CPU4× phone profile are retained, the gate requires at least 59 fps with p95 ≤18 ms, and an independent verifier recomputes every statistic and checks 28 source fingerprints. Timing runs and recordings have separate scope.

Validation for exact delivery head **41c5dbdc8358b34ac692207c6257bc6b2c6400f8**:
- Full [GitHub Actions run 37819318398](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37819318398) passed on 2026-10-08 at 17:56:34 UTC. Its actual 97,833-character job log verifies 24 core tests, 10,000 independent solver cases, 1,003 property seeds, 7,000 roster games, both 2,000-game bot leagues, all 25 actual mutation kills, 304,912 malformed probes and 17,119 baseline-compatible transitions.
- Fifteen JSON files, eleven schemas, two byte-identical full regenerations and 51 hashes pass. The 2,000-level generation/certificate/solver benchmark peaks at 2.678 ms. README is 44 lines.
- Actual file:// Chrome 154 produced 900 unfiltered intervals for each profile: **TV 60.0024 fps / phone CPU4× 60.0024 fps**, both p95 16.7 ms. All 28 source guards match; controls complete with every roster 2–8, zero runtime errors and no network requests beyond the offline document. An independent local verifier recomputed all 1,800 intervals from the downloaded final artifact against the current source.
- All **108 actual-record corruption controls** pass: 73 frame controls, 10 grant controls and 25 separate-capture controls. Current capture13 is source-bound and independently verified; its 103,087-byte clip decodes as 36 VP9 frames over 3.6 seconds. Encoded 10 fps describes video delivery rather than rendering acceptance.
- The genuine [final uploaded artifact 11569291582](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37819318398/artifacts/11569291582) contains nine files. Downloaded ZIP: **193,572 bytes**, SHA256 **b63c4c0906a4b917f32ee74e8a2035a3952bf7f8aa6bd13b4fc235928e65bfb9**, matching official metadata. Its fresh 107,410-byte video also matches its own recorded SHA256 and decodes as VP9, 1280×900, 36 frames, 3.6 seconds.

The first local actual-file attempt failed the same 59 fps gate: Chromium 141 TV 57.633 fps, p95 16.8 / p99 33.3 / max 216.6 ms; all 900 intervals and 28 guards are retained, and phone did not run. No unchanged frame retry or causal browser/hardware explanation was used. An earlier HTTP setup timed out with zero sampled frames. Earlier 9362 hosted evidence remains explicitly historical. The phone profile uses Chrome CPU emulation; human solve rates remain unmeasured.

KEEP GOING: the original R10–R12 three-round player stop remains met because gameplay bytes are unchanged. The single completed R14 adds verification evidence without claiming a player gain; its earlier checkpoint is historical. NEXT.md freezes the exact-head resume gate, and this final receipt records its completion without a prose-only follow-up commit.

pr.title: G04 Reality Check: deadline fairness and verified offline game
pr.body:
Reality Check is the complete offline quiz and bluff game for 2–8 players. Expired timers are consumed before human or bot inputs, preventing late scoring and expired fakes. This follow-up makes the browser and capture evidence independently checkable while preserving the accepted game, UI, bots and data.

Final head `c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927` passes the [complete hosted workflow](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37846802513), completed at 21:36:03 UTC on 2026-10-08. The full native job 113549581497 log was retrieved and read: 51 tests, 1,003 replay seeds, 21,000 count/mode bot games, 1,000 timer-only rosters, both 10,000-case independent differentials, all 25 real mutation kills, 24,000 default/held-out skill matches, the actual compiled deadline mutant and eight boundary controls, 66 offline gameplay controls, four strict proof tests, all 18 capture refusal controls, and 154 final data/media checksums pass.

The strengthened verifier binds all 1,034 current source inputs, the shared contract, public pinned modules, and actual Node/encoder/decoder identities. It retains 600 consecutive native intervals and 601 timestamp/active phase/private-draft/countdown/clock witnesses per profile, writing raw evidence before assertions. Actual Play, real Pause/Resume and seven bot callbacks remain observable; stale or mismatched three-key nonce grants are rejected. The final hosted run uses fresh independent attempts without transferring the local coordination grant.

- Desktop 1920×1080: 60.003000 FPS; CPU4 phone approximation 390×844: 60.002400 FPS. Both p95/p99 are approximately 16.8 ms, under the unchanged original mean≥59 FPS/p95≤18 ms gate.
- All six original 300-interval profiles also pass, at 60.001200–60.003600 FPS. All 3,000 original and strict intervals remain unfiltered.
- Both current functional clips decode completely: desktop 183,505 bytes and phone 157,680 bytes, each 24 VP8 frames at 12 encoded FPS. All three original 36-frame desktop clips decode completely as well. Capture playback rate is not the measured game FPS.

The genuine final artifact 11580178889 is 1,444,862 bytes, with official SHA256 `56f9427d827bd42cb74b5656842e75dc1fb30402281fd1a15e80607756944a3c`. The public [independent reader](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927/jobs/G04-reality-check/verify-hosted-artifact.py) passed 10,862 assertions at 21:40:34 UTC over its actual 20 safe ZIP entries, exact source identities, all raw intervals and witnesses, 66 controls, and full decoding of all five actual clips. Its SHA256 is `32db337f565c453723b4b0dcad8f190b8460f17cc1006a9ba2f08e5591bc01b7`. Run it from the job folder with the genuine ZIP saved as `actual.zip` and official metadata as `artifact-metadata.json` in the evidence folder:

```sh
python verify-hosted-artifact.py --head c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927 --run-id 37846802513 --evidence-dir <evidence-folder>
```

The actual genuine Playwright encoder and explicitly installed system decoder are distinguished. Hosted Node is 24.21.0; supported decoder is `/usr/bin/ffmpeg`, version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5, SHA256 `ed16af623947494a72e284b6eb8ff225f2da22b38b5d5069c2fd4b4ba3384e41`. The workflow installs it explicitly and preserves exact shared package bytes with `--no-save`. The [public verification record](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/c81b0b7e69b19782613debbc1296c6d56f556927/jobs/G04-reality-check/VERIFY.md) retains the genuine earlier pinned-decoder exit234 failure, failed auxiliary comparison and actual package reproduction, local decoder symlink distinction, interruption gaps and coordination target misses. The earlier accepted 7e077efa artifact and independent receipt are archived with their own exact head.

All sampled runtime source inputs and the entire strict sampler remain byte-identical from accepted 7e077efa to final c81b0b7; the final checkpoint adds only documentation, saved evidence and the separate post-run reader. Actual player KEEP rounds12–14 retain their three-round no-gain stop. This follow-up was normally pushed at observed 21:26:29 UTC and only G04's main claim was refreshed. Physical-phone performance is not claimed. Original source research uncertainties remain explicitly scoped in SOURCES.md.

pr.title: Add Hearts core and offline hot-seat table for 3–6 players
pr.body:
Adds Standard Hearts for 3–6 players with a pure deterministic TypeScript core and a self-contained offline hot-seat page. Settings cover documented deck adjustments, rotating private passes, both moon scores and optional J♦ scoring. Three bot levels use private views; held-out 2,000-game leagues measure strong over medium at 71.10% and medium over easy at 77.95%.

The page provides concealed handoffs, optional clocks, mouse/touch/keyboard controls, locally saved recovery, privately marked received cards and accessible outcomes. Manage holds the clock and selected pass. Player/core/browser/art/data/native frame sampler remain byte-identical to the original 3c28358 delivery.

The verifier binds 30 immutable inputs, fully decodes the actual current 36-frame 1920×1080 VP9 recording, retains every decoded framehash, and records that clip's host Node and decoder executable/version/SHA/arguments. It checks source/tool bytes again after decoding. Four genuine, coherently hashed negative files cover non-video, truncation, a fully decodable one-frame substitute and a fully decodable phone-shaped substitute. The delivered Python reader independently checks official ZIP bytes, immutable source, every native interval and every actual decoded frame.

Final exact head **85d373c5c7eaa946acc84ed316098d63fa4eac8b** passed both complete [push checks](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37851902643) and [PR checks](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37851908687). Full native logs were read independently: 37 tests, 25 real mutation kills, 1,003 replay seeds, 1,000 complete bot games at every 3–6-player count, 10,000 independent comparisons, two 2,000-game strength leagues, 38 validated JSON files, 29 research receipts and two byte-identical 96-file regenerations all passed.

Both genuine final artifacts were downloaded with official complete bytes/digests and independently accepted: **137 public-reader and 286 separate private-reader assertions per artifact**, all 30 current Git/package inputs, 1,200 native intervals, 20 functionals, four media controls and all 36 actual decoded frames each. Push artifact **11582072044**, 937,146 bytes, SHA256 bee51b88de3d3e2137253f6c1b563f5107d3d976003c126ed8e8e00b9fa84b28; PR artifact **11582646194**, 937,279 bytes, SHA256 c520b822aa9f32fd9776aa6a6085595dde9a8532d1239a0d6f094d8db41f6046. Current host Node24.21 and FFmpeg6.1.1 identities/commands are bound; all 36 decoded pixel/PTS/DTS/duration/byte rows agree with actual independent FFmpeg7.1.5 decoding. Different host binaries and output headers are separately scoped.

Both full runs retain 600 consecutive unfiltered intervals per desktop and CPU4× phone after the original explicit 60-frame warmup. All four measured profiles are about60.002–60.003 FPS with p95/p99 about16.7–16.8ms under unchanged ≥59 mean FPS / p95≤18ms gates. This describes the steady-state private-pass selection workload, not startup or a physical phone; the original runner has no per-frame native-API/phase witnesses. Fresh milestone18's 20 functionals/3–6 rosters/30 equal input maps/full decoded clip are separately scoped nongating evidence.

Previous65a310b and original3c actual artifacts/logs/executed readers are preserved publicly. Old local58.634/57.695/55.047 FPS failures and auxiliary/publication-order failures remain visible; causes are not invented and unchanged local FPS workloads were not retried for luck. Original KEEP11–13 genuinely completed three consecutive reviews with no noticeable player gain; unchanged gameplay preserves that stop. MIT original code/art and Zod notice are retained; shared contracts are unchanged. Delivery is ready for review and remains unmerged.

pr.title: G06: partnership and Cutthroat Spades core with offline hot-seat play
pr.body:
Complete offline Spades with four-player partnerships and three-player cutthroat, nil/blind nil, bags and 500-point matches, private handovers, optional exchange and three bot strengths. The zero-deficit blind-nil setting now correctly describes tied or trailing teams; eligibility and strategy are unchanged.

Final head 48430c9861534edfef8c59528de4279ebd6cec78 passed the complete G06 workflow 37807419404 at 16:28:19 UTC: strict types and byte-identical data/page checks, two 10,000-case differentials, 31 core tests, 25 real mutation kills, 1,003 presence cases, 16,000 skill games, 13 browser groups and three exact UI/core matches. Twenty-one focused groups also passed, including 58 current-source evidence corruption controls, nine nonce protocol groups and twelve real capture CLI rejection controls. Capture requires one explicit valid unused milestone and refuses existing video/report files before browser launch.

I downloaded the actual final five-file artifact 11565005070 and verified its 104,184-byte ZIP against GitHub's SHA-256 13aaf20b75d803750dbfbb999304ab1480bb2c3fb9cbdc8b5908f0bc6d2cd294. Independent validation recomputed all 1,800 unfiltered intervals and checked eighteen current source guards: TV and CPU4 phone both 60.0028 FPS, p95 16.7/16.8 ms. The actual source-bound milestone13 clip is 95,085 bytes, SHA-256 1df6c6c07b08a336fa171b5b83772e8de30c424b4b308e1957d27ffb5c73bd7b, with ten matching guards and zero application/network errors.

Review rounds 10–12 produced three consecutive rounds without a player-facing gain after the visible setting-label correction; the final independent audit found no substantive gap. The local TV failure at 58.381 FPS, phone-not-run status and unresolved cause remain recorded separately from hosted success. CPU4 approximates a phone; encoded 12 FPS clips document functionality and do not measure frame-rate acceptance.

pr.title: G07: deliver verified Perudo game and exact-odds bots
pr.body:
Perudo-style Liar’s Dice for 2–8 players, with private cups, wild-one and palifico settings, optional calza, exact probabilities and a learned bluffing model. The standalone offline page adds adjustable bot pacing, validated same-tab recovery, complete standings and supported custom player IDs.

The current verification repair binds Resume clock checks to the real trusted click task, retains the original 200/250 ms limits and consumes real time before saving so a full-clock reset cannot pass. Complete acceptance requires all 94 original checks, exact desktop/CPU4 phone profiles, all 1,200 consecutive native intervals, recomputed metrics and 32 actual source guards. The active eight-seat/forty-die/existing-bid/open-cup/exact-odds workload must remain unchanged across READY, grant and sampling. The >=59 mean FPS and <=17 ms p99 gates remain unchanged; incomplete sidecars and historical positives cannot substitute for complete current proof.

Final head: **1cc4a9709a60783ecad45476c02668d62f4c8a4a**. [Exact-head run 37835172268](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37835172268) succeeded at **2026-10-08 20:02:55 UTC**. Its actual 137,990-character job log confirms 116/116 tests, 25 actual assertion-killed mutations, full 94/94 browser checks, all 1,200 raw intervals/32 guards, 88 current corruption controls and 443 integrity hashes with two byte-identical fixture regenerations. Gameplay, session, page and the 1,493-byte native timed callback remain unchanged; KEEP GOING rounds 6–8 still establish three consecutive reviews without player-visible gain.

The genuine final artifact **11575897174** was downloaded and independently validated with **1,387 Python assertions**, including every actual guarded source byte, all raw intervals, real click observations and workload boundaries. ZIP: **1,249,263 bytes**, SHA256 **b0765a5995d353f111d5019034bbc300f378dd20956a57e0f61a9278f9c916fd**. Actual final hosted desktop/phone rates are **60.002400/60.001800 FPS**, with p99/max **16.8 ms** and no discarded intervals. The permanently committed earlier 41f6226 official ZIP/raw proof and offline reader independently reproduce the same unchanged checker/game source; they remain explicitly tied to that earlier successful run.

Retained failures remain visible. The local full run is **93/94 EXIT1** because a phone calza pre-click RPC time-bound assertion failed before actual-dispatch checking; its elapsed value was not recorded, so no product cause is claimed. Both local strict profiles passed **60.002400/59.310808 FPS**, p99 **16.8 ms**, with the actual phone maximum **66.7 ms** retained. The complete checker correctly rejects that failed full report. Earlier local clock/FPS failures, interrupted output and an unsampled player-map guard error remain archived. The map-count error is corrected. No unchanged local timing retry, threshold waiver or erased failure is claimed. The reset’s push-cadence gap is also recorded.

Separate new five-round recordings use the unchanged page, have zero errors/network and fully decode as actual VP8 streams: desktop **935,764 bytes** / phone **956,240 bytes**, both below 10 MB. Their recorded 25 FPS is separate from native performance proof; VERIFY and the receipts contain the exact ffprobe/ffmpeg commands and actual argv.

Historical gameplay validation includes 7,000 complete games (1,000 per roster 2–8), 20,000 independent probability differentials, default-duel Strong **64.70%** / Medium **58.90%** and a separate fresh holdout **66.8%/57.0%**. Twelve-source research, edition choices, licenses and reproduction are recorded in SOURCES, CONFLICTS, BOTS, VERIFY and EVIDENCE. Physical-phone testing, full SDK integration and multiplayer/variant strategy advantage remain unproved.

pr.title: G08: verify Shake Up and deliver original-client offline play
pr.body:
Completes verification and offline delivery of the owner's existing Shake Up game. The self-contained `play.html` opens from disk for 1–16 people/bots, English/Spanish, 4×4/5×5 boards, and private turns on a shared device. Contract adapters, dictionary rebuilding and independent solver checks retain the original authored game and its models, CSS and films. Player fixes cover phone layout and tied winners, restart confirmation, keyboard focus, Spanish host controls, bot observation and complete awards.

Resume now shows the current real hunt clock immediately: a real two-second Pause previously inflated the TV countdown by 2 seconds and the phone countdown by 3; both now preserve the remaining time. The existing 250 ms render trigger remains. The page is 14,208,702 bytes, reproduced byte-for-byte twice, SHA-256 `3763b7f89abc81838abfd48c0f7a10f6ae734e9db0b08b41a6f98334322a866e`.

Final source is [`b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7`](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/commit/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7). BOTH exact-head full workflow events passed, and both downloaded artifacts were independently accepted against all 183 immutable Git inputs at start and end:

| Event | Full run | Complete log | Accepted artifact ZIP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Push | [37851602313](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37851602313), SUCCESS at 22:17:38 UTC | 159,342 UTF-16 code units; 104 JSON records | 11583280328; 1,782,721 bytes; SHA-256 `4d0c97cc2b9d2a25abbd1315adb8f9d253d2e33f3c72416a2558bb07481723ff` |
| Pull request | [37851608280](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37851608280), SUCCESS at 22:15:56 UTC | 160,165 UTF-16 code units; 104 JSON records | 11583020705; 1,650,295 bytes; SHA-256 `e47d4fc5f347c3efebc6695c8880b01c7c09e0317a45c155352bf47833de7d9c` |

Each ZIP has 57 safe unique entries and passes the complete CRC and digest checks. Each contains all four exact English 4×4 / Spanish 5×5 TV 1920×1080 and phone 390×844 / CPU4 profiles: 600 unfiltered native intervals per profile, live advancing hunt clocks, about 60.002–60.003 FPS, p95 at most 16.8 ms, and no page errors or outgoing requests. Both sets total 4,800 intervals. All 22 native functional gates and rosters 1/2/3/8/16 pass. All ten original VP8 clips were fully decoded, hash checked and matched to their recorded metadata. Actual Pause holds are 2,000.390575 ms (push) and 2,000.105383 ms (PR), preserving 90→90→90 seconds.

All 16 pipeline stages pass: strict ES2022 TypeScript; 20 test files / 185 assertions; 24 of 25 actual behavioral mutant kills; 50,000 research grids / 10,000 independent solver comparisons / 2,383,756 validated paths; 1,003 adversarial replays and 1,000 complete games for EACH roster 1–16; both 2,000-game bot leagues; two byte-identical dictionary and fixture rebuilds; 57 JSON schemas; committed checksums and 29 protected original visual files; real disk playback; 23 raw-evidence rejection controls and 19 native-capture rejection controls. The 59 FPS / p95≤20 ms / 600-interval gates, page CSP and ≥2,000 ms Pause requirement remain intact. [Reproduction and artifact-reader commands](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/review/REPRODUCE.md) document the tools and exact evidence scopes.

Formal KEEP rounds 10/11/12 each reread the instructions, ranked five weaknesses, fixed the worst remaining issue and measured the result. They are three consecutive reviews with no player-facing gain after round 9's real clock improvement, satisfying the stopping rule. Final reviews clarify proof navigation, reconcile the actually read primary manuals and all newly observed unchosen variants, and publish two artifact-reader recipes actually exercised on the preceding accepted artifact. The page and all 183 runtime/proof inputs remain unchanged through these reviews. [Final review](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/review/keep12/README.md), [loop](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/LOOP.md) and [conditional delivery handoff](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/NEXT.md) retain that scope; no further cosmetic source commit is required after this final acceptance.

Historical failures remain preserved in [recovery09](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/review/repair09/RECOVERY.md), [repair11](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/review/repair11/README.md), [repair12](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/review/repair12/README.md), [repair13](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/review/repair13/README.md) and [repair14](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/blob/b76da07787351bcc83b3f6287f4f501942e69ff7/jobs/G08-word-grid/review/repair14/README.md). The local current-page English phone observation failed at 57.6947 FPS while TV passed at 60.0024 FPS; local Spanish profiles were NOT RUN, and the cause remains unresolved. No unchanged local FPS retry or filtering was used. The second restart lost the native-only session's exit and termination time; its persisted source-bound report and decoded clips were accepted separately as partial evidence. The earlier 1,999.752709 ms sibling Pause failure, real 30-minute installer timeout/partial artifact, bounded installer exit 124/no-test outcome and their successful siblings remain separate actual results. Concrete capture and official Ubuntu mirror repairs preserve all thresholds, source definitions, package trust and fatal bounds.

Both manufacturer manuals were later actually read and reconciled with the older denied requests. Complete physical cube-face/Spanish edition authentication and production SDK audio/3D/UI runtime remain explicit re-verification scope; the job permits the supplied test/offline bindings. No commercial PDF, logo or image was copied. The branch is normally pushed, the own G08 claim was refreshed on main at 22:09:04 UTC, and this PR is open for review without a merge or force push.

pr.title: G09: deliver Category Rush core and offline play
pr.body:
Category Rush delivers a complete offline game for 2–8 players: 320 original prompts, 4,155 authored examples, seeded rounds, private answer sheets and anonymous ballots, duplicate cancellation, three bot skills, saved-game recovery and scored receipts. Its pure TypeScript core follows the shared contract.

Pasted article/tab/vertical-tab/DEL answers retain visible word boundaries before private advice, saving and submission. Fourteen native clipboard cases at two/eight humans rescue six formerly zero-point authored answers; eight ordinary/newline controls retain their score. Caret, backward selection, 80-character bounds, private handovers and negative scoring controls pass.

Final acceptance is fully green on exact `7f5a0bda747fdb79b350f7780cff6b655bc2b3ad`: [run 37847981850](https://github.com/luisitin/partybox-game-cores/actions/runs/37847981850), job 113553541133, completed at 21:57:17 UTC. The complete 147,400-character log confirms 69 tests/pass 69/fail 0, both 10,000-case independent oracles, 7,000 restored games/all nine invariants, 1,003 property seeds, 43 actual mutation kills, 4,000 bot duels, deterministic regeneration and every original/new browser stage. The fresh late-save artifact checker also passes after replay.

The genuine official artifacts were downloaded and independently checked against their exact source/run, ZIP digest, safe entries and actual payloads:

- Strict artifact **11581130237**: 1,349,771 bytes; SHA-256 `20cd883cb07a673eaa2bf8eb267087e9d783772703b77245fa708aceedb362d4`. All eight files, 18 source guards, 1,200 native frame intervals and 1,202 active-answer/native-clock/timer witnesses pass. Desktop/phone-4x measure 60.002976/60.003180 FPS with p99/max 16.8 ms; timers advance 60→50. Both genuine 353,472/265,754-byte VP8 recordings fully decode.
- Recovery/late artifact **11580709186**: 3,031,477 bytes; SHA-256 `ba11e7b3b420ed1116501e9be8acf0520c9bb4e1eb54fc800cb86870db56eafa`. Its 50 safe files pass 10,377 independent assertions covering 17 fresh recovery controls, twelve authentic legacy-save pairs and the native late-game workload. All 29 archived save payloads decode as valid using the current decoder.

Legacy saves transfer byte-for-byte from the older page into the current page. Private handover hides old drafts, preserves 53 seconds through a 120-second functional wait, then writing advances the timer to 48 seconds. Eight valid cases score one; four repeat/wrong-initial cases score zero.

The fresh late-game replay actually plays four complete eight-human rounds and 384 private scored groups, then retains a 94,429-byte fifth-round handover with 84 submitted long answers. Both profiles record 960 trusted character inputs. All twelve 80-character drafts save and recover privately with history, scores, RNG and elapsed writing time intact. Two navigation initializer attempts produce one seed write. The actual 271,283-byte phone recording fully decodes 118 VP8 frames over 4.72 seconds. Nineteen current source guards and every trusted character prefix match. These native input observations add no FPS sample or hard handler-latency gate.

The first local late-game observer remains archived: typing/saving passed, but its every-navigation test initializer overwrote the new draft on reload; phone and capture were not run. Only that isolated seed-once setup was corrected. The corrected local phone observer's actual 55 ms long task retains an unresolved cause; differences between local/hosted attempts are not an optimization claim. Earlier local phone FPS failure, expired-handover scope, rejected extra-key pre-sampling grant and unsupported extra Date-versus-RAF diagnostic failure also remain intact. Original gates are unchanged. Phone 4x approximates a device; English morphology and storage-latency coverage remain bounded.

KEEP GOING is complete: seven measured player gains followed by three actual reviews without a new player-visible gain. LOOP.md, audits and NEXT.md retain the stop condition, resume instructions and failures. The final evidence reviews leave production HTML/core/data/bots/RNG/save format unchanged. The completion was normally pushed at 21:36:30 UTC and only the G09 main claim was refreshed.

rows.head: a04fe98cc878985700812c60654c5578cba5e1f7

pr.title: G10: checkers startup fix; standalone delivery blocked
pr.body:
This implements American 8×8 and International 10×10 checkers with deterministic rules, a 6,000-node bot and the complete licensed 2–6-piece endgame database. The International worker now becomes ready when its genuine database has loaded, and the page waits for incomplete database blocks while parsing continues. Malformed blocks still fail.

Permanent standalone delivery is blocked: both the configured full-file Release upload and a separate 76-byte checksum upload returned HTTP 401 from uploads.github.com. The owned Release draft remains unpublished with zero assets. The complete local offline file is preserved; no public download or completed job is claimed.

Validation:

- The exact two-file change passed the original strict TypeScript check and complete 1,390,847,100-byte offline build. All 1,341 recorded source/compiler/dependency/runtime guards stayed equal during the build. The rules, bot strategy, full database, licenses and original performance gates are preserved.
- A saved, independently reviewed native comparison verified four complete HTTP responses and eight legal game/report/RNG replays. The first legal move arrived 17.517 seconds earlier on desktop and 73.472 seconds earlier in the declared phone profile; both candidate moves preceded DOMContentLoaded.
